maya: Quick heads-up: the canary run for rerank-hero-7b (int8) shows a strange regression. NDCG +0.8% overall but MRR down ~4.2%.
maya: digging... short queries (<6 tokens) MRR is -12% vs baseline.
raj: ouch. can you paste the slice numbers and where this came from (holdout vs prod)?
maya: holdout=prod-mirror-2026-03-15, batch eval with seed=42. overall numbers: baseline MRR 0.432 -> canary 0.414.
maya: short-query slice: baseline 0.221 -> canary 0.194. long queries no material drop.
linh: first thought: is tokenization or priming length different between the two runners? small-token queries are sensitive to priming.
omar: also candidate ordering could differ (we shuffle top-k in the bringup harness?). any change in pre-sort?
maya: I checked: ranking candidates are same; we didn't change candidate pool. suspecting quant noise on small logits.
maya: eval command we ran:
```bash
python tools/eval_rerank.py \
  --model rerank-hero-7b \
  --quant int8 \
  --holdout prod-mirror-2026-03-15 \
  --slice "len(query)<6" \
  --seed 42 \
  --save-raw
```
raj: can you re-run with fixed-batching (no dynamic batches) and controlled KV cache? sometimes batching order affects MRR.
linh: also try forcing tokenizer parity: `--tokenizer v1.2` and `--no-priming` to rule out prompt prefix effects.
omar: +1. maybe run float16 (no quant) on same host to check hardware/ops differences.
maya: next steps proposed:
- rerun int8 with fixed-batching + token parity + seed=42 (maya)
- run float16 baseline on same infrastructure (omar)
- generate per-example diff for short queries and inspect logits (linh)
- hold canary at 0% if regression reproduces in local canary mirrored traffic (raj)
maya: canary status: deploy-bot: canary deployment completed -> 10% traffic (03:02:40 UTC) :warning:
deploy-bot: rollback queued if MRR drop > 2.0% on core slice
raj: timeline? can you kick off reruns now?
maya: already started rerun, ETA ~20m. will paste artifacts when done.
linh: thx. if we confirm quant is the cause maybe try per-layer mixed quant or 4bit for attention-only.
omar: noted. If we need to pause rollout ping me and infra will drain traffic.
maya: will update with artifact link when rerun finishes.
